en: The postcard shows a panoramic view of a town with distinct rocky outcrops, each topped with notable structures, including a statue and a church. The foreground consists of fields, while the middle and background are densely built-up with historical buildings. The postcard is monochrome, suggesting it is from an earlier period. The caption at the bottom reads: 'LE PUY. - Vue générale des Quatre Rochers. - LL.'
